stem: Leela packs lunch. Which choices support healthy eating as wholesome food, in a sensible amount, eaten at a suitable time? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: The smallest possible nibble of dal, because the smallest portion is always the healthiest.
A bowl of dal and rice at midday, in an amount she can finish without feeling stuffed.
Fruit after games, because it is wholesome and the timing fits her hunger.
A brightly iced cupcake, chosen only because the icing is colourful.

teacher.key_rationale: Healthy eating here is wholesome food, a sensible amount, at a suitable time. Dal-rice at lunch and fruit after games fit. Tiny-as-always and colour-only do not.
